Contract/cascade summary: Prometheus evaluates rules into pending/firing/inactive alert instances, serializes labels/annotations/timestamps to Alertmanager v2 `PostableAlerts`, and periodically resends or reports resolution. Alertmanager validates and stores those alerts, assigns timeout-based resolution when `EndsAt` is absent, then adds fingerprints, receivers, and suppression state in its v2 read API. Grafana consumes Prometheus rule/alert state and Alertmanager v2 alert state, translating Prometheus lowercase states into its own alert-state model. Migration should preserve `alertname`, labels, annotations, `StartsAt`/`EndsAt`, `GeneratorURL`, and v2 OpenAPI fields; test missing `EndsAt`, resolved alerts, fingerprints, state filters, and Grafana’s state translation when changing any upstream format.
